---
title: Prompts
description: Prompts are saved team instructions you run from the / menu to start or steer a session.
---

import { Aside } from "@astrojs/starlight/components"
import PlatformShots from "../../../../components/PlatformShots.astro"

A prompt is a name, an icon and a markdown body, saved for the whole team. Write it once, then run it from the `/` menu. The session it starts picks its device, agent and repository like any other [session](/docs/using/sessions/).

## Settings → Prompts

<PlatformShots view="settings-prompts" />

**Settings → Prompts** lists the team's prompts. **New prompt** opens the editor: the icon and name over the body, then **Create prompt**. Opening a row opens the same page with **Save changes** and **Delete prompt**.

Owners create, edit and delete prompts. Every member can read and run them.

## Start a session with a prompt

<PlatformShots view="composer-slash-menu" platforms={["web"]} />

In the **Agent** page's composer, type `/` to list the team's prompts, keep typing to filter, then press **Enter** or click one. The prompt becomes the session's subject, and sending starts a new session with its body followed by what you typed.

## Use a prompt in a live session

<PlatformShots view="session-slash-menu" platforms={["web"]} />

In a running session, `/` lists `/compact`, `/new`, `/model` and `/effort` first, then the prompts. Picking a prompt puts its body in your draft to edit before you send.

## Prompts over MCP

Agents read prompts with the [`exponential_prompts`](/docs/build/mcp/) tool (`list`, `get`); owners also `create`, `update` and `delete` them with `exponential_prompts_write`. `exponential_sessions_send` takes a `promptId` to start a session with a prompt's body first.

<Aside>
Prompts run when someone picks them. To run work on a schedule or when an event happens, give an agent a trigger: see [Sessions](/docs/using/sessions/).
</Aside>
